Uses of Class
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.Builder

Packages that use Builder
Package
Description
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent
Eloquent models: one class per table over the query builder, in the style of Laravel's Eloquent.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations
Eloquent relations: the relation types a model declares, their name map, and their exceptions.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql
PostgreSQL support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into PostgreSQL SQL, the query grammar and processor, and a migration lock built on advisory locks.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query
The query builder: build reads and writes fluently and compile them to SQL for one database.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.sqlite
SQLite support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into SQLite SQL, and the query grammar and processor that run the query builder on SQLite.
